_comment: Track D1 canonical example-playbook set. Each fixture maps to one authoring scenario and the acceptance outcome the widget must produce. Box-specific values (workflow IRIs from a D2 seed, captured execution ids) live in scenarios.local.json (gitignored) keyed by the same `id` — never commit box IPs/creds/ids here.

scenarios.expect: Explain describes the flow; Optimize proposes only non-breaking refinements (no invented regressions).
analyze/diagnose flags the unresolved next-reference; apply-patch offers to repoint it; after apply, verify_enhancement is clean.
add-error-handling proposes a decision/failure route after the mutating op; verify_enhancement shows steps added, no removals.
add-a-step inserts exactly one new step and re-wires next; update_playbook lands it on the same workflow uuid (not a new collection).
diagnose_yaml_against_pb_execution ties the captured run failure to `Handle match`'s unpopulated Jinja path.
